definitions.name: Aelfborn
definitions.description:
The sterile offspring of Human and Elf unions, these beings
 are distrusted by both Man and Elf-kind.

definitions.name: Aracoix
definitions.description:
Strangers from another world, these winged humanoids can fly,
 but have little aptitude for magic.

definitions.name: Nephilim
definitions.description:
Often called the Tainted Ones, Nephilim are winged fusions 
of Human and Demon from the Pit of Chaos. They are renowned 
for their strange beauty, their cruelty, and their aptitude 
with magic.
definitions.effect:
+30 to Fire Resistance
+30 to Lightning Resistance
+30 to Magic Resitstance
+30 to Mental Resistance
+30 to Poison Resistance
+30 to Cold Resistance
+30 to Unholy Resistance
Granted 'Mundane Eidolon' power
Granted 'Flight' ability

definitions.name: Assassin
definitions.description:
Skilled in the arts of dealing death, Assassins are users of
poison and stealth. They use the mysterious power of
Shadowmastery, which allows them to shape and use living
shadow to slay their targets.

definitions.name: Elf
definitions.description:
One-time masters of the world, the Elves' power was broken 
long ago, their empires scattered and destroyed, yet they 
retain their arrogance.
definitions.effect:
+5 to Magic resistance
-5 to Poison resistance
+10 to Sword skill
-15 to Heal Resistance

definitions.name: Half-Giant
definitions.description:
Mortals born with a touch of the blood of Giants within them, 
these folk grow to massive size -- half again the height of a 
tall human -- and are as strong and hardy as they are tall.
definitions.effect:
+5 to Cold resistance
-5 to Fire resistance
+10 to Axe skill
+10 to Great Axe Mastery
+10 to Great Hammer Mastery
+10 to Great Sword Master
Granted Athletics and Toughness skills
Granted 'Undaunted' power

definitions.name: Rogue
definitions.description:
Stealthy and unscrupulous, rogues excel at 
the pilfering arts and dishonorable combat.

definitions.name: Human
definitions.description:
Granted 20 Extra Stat Points
Most common of the races of the world of Shadowbane, Humans 
are the rightful children of the All-Father and inheritors 
of the world.

definitions.name: Dwarf
definitions.description:
Shaped from raw stone itself, the Dwarves were once the 
servants of Thurin and the All-Father beneath the earth.
definitions.effect:
+10 to Slashing resistance
+10 to Piercing resistance
+5 to Crushing resistance
+5 to Lightning resistance
-5 to Magic resistance
-5 to Unholy resistance
+10 to Axe skill
+10 to Hammer skill
Granted Toughness skill

definitions.name: Irekei
definitions.description:
Strange crimson-skinned inhabitants of the mighty deserts, 
the Irekei are fearsome raiders and nomads.
definitions.effect:
-10 to Cold resistance
+20 to Fire resistance
+10 to Dagger skill
+10 to Unarmed Combat skill

definitions.name: Centaur
definitions.description:
Proud and strong fusions of horse and man, the Centaurs are 
the largest and swiftest of the races of the world.
definitions.effect:
-5 to Unholy resistance
Improved Stamina recovery
+10 to Spear skill

definitions.name: Minotaur
definitions.description:
Half-man, half-bull, the offspring of a sorcerous experiment 
by Elves upon Humans, the slow-witted but powerful 
Minotaurs were used for labor and as shock troops.
definitions.effect:
+10 to Pole Arm skill
+5 to Slashing, Piercing, Crushing resistance
+20 to Cold resistance
-5 to Magic resistance
-10 to Mental resistance
Immune to Stun
Improved Health recovery
Granted Toughness skill

definitions.name: Vampire
definitions.description:
Unholy terrors born of other races, Vampires are reborn in 
undeath through pacts with the Void. Their dead flesh is 
uncannily resilient, but must drink the blood of the living 
to survive.
definitions.effect:

definitions.name: Saetor
definitions.description: Half goat half man, the Saetor race does the bidding of the Chaos Gods.
definitions.effect:
+15 to Staff skill
Granted Staff skill
Granted Parry skill
Granted Staff Mastery skill

definitions.name: Healer
definitions.description:
Blessed with powers of healing and prayer, the Healers 
worship their gods in different ways.

definitions.name: Barbarian
definitions.description:
Hardy and fierce, these warriors of the Frozen North are
bold and competent in battle. Toughened by a rough life
among the glaciers, Barbarians are capable of uncanny
feats of endurance and strength.

definitions.name: Bard
definitions.description:
Keepers of lore and wandering musicians, Bards are gifted
with magical powers born of verse and song. Their songs
can bring victory to their allies as readily as they bring
woe to the Bard's enemies.

definitions.name: Fighter
definitions.description:
The most direct of the fighting classes, these individuals 
have found cold steel to be the most reliable way 
to make one's point.

definitions.name: Channeler
definitions.description:
Magic-users who have managed to tap the primal forces of
fire, water, wind, and earth, Channelers use the energies
of the Cosmic Tapestry to blast their foes, ride the
winds, and call up elemental spirits.

definitions.name: Confessor
definitions.description:
Priests of the Temple of the Cleansing Flame, these clerics
are charged with seeking out and eliminating sin in the
world. In the course of their sacred duties they bring
aid to the ill and fiery death to unbelievers.

definitions.name: Fury
definitions.description:
Amazonian warrior-witches, Furies are children of storms -
wild and untamable, commanding lightning and tempest.
Fierce and proud, Furies are as powerful as they are
unpredictable.

definitions.name: Druid
definitions.description:
Attuned to the forces of nature and the wild, these woods-
priests are the keepers of much secret knowledge and lore.
Druids are allies to plants, beasts, and those who live
in harmony with the wild.

definitions.name: Crusader
definitions.description:
Defenders of the Church of the All-Father, these blessed
warriors have taken up arms to defend the weak from those
who would threaten the Church's power. Soldiers of faith,
Crusaders wander the world earning redemption in battle.

definitions.name: Huntress
definitions.description:
Women who live by the ancient traditions of the Amazons,
the Huntresses are at home upon battlefield and forest.
They often are found with great cats for allies, and are
deadly in combat.

definitions.name: Prelate
definitions.description:
The spiritual arm of the Church of the All-Father, these
servants of Pandarrion spread the gospel of the All-Father
and minister to the needy and the weak. Though they are
less aggressive than Crusaders, do not mistake them for
pacifists!

definitions.name: Ranger
definitions.description:
Long associated with the ancient Druids, these secretive 
and solitary wardens of the forest walk a fine line, defending 
innocents from savage nature while protecting the wilderness 
from the ravages of civilization.

definitions.name: Scout
definitions.description:
Charged with exploration, battlefield reconnaissance, and
guiding travelers through long-hidden ways, the Scout is a
combination of Ranger, Rogue, and Warrior. Masters of the
bow, most find work as mercenaries or spies.

definitions.name: Templar
definitions.description:
Created as the militant wing of the Temple of the Cleansing
Flame, the fanatical, armored knights of the Order of
Templars combat the sinful and wicked in St. Malorn's
name. Zealous beyond reason, Templars live for battle.
